title: Practice Log

certification.title: Certification for Rookie Drivers
certification.text: I hereby certify that {student_name}, who is under 25 years of age, has had a minimum of 60 hours behind the wheel driving practice, has demonstrated that they can safely operate a motor vehicle, and has been under the supervision of a valid license holder 21 years of age or older, who has been licensed for at least three years.

signatures.label: Signature of parent, guardian, mentor, or coach

certification.extra_text: OR I hereby certify that ________, who is 25 years of age or older, has had a minimum of 14 hours behind the wheel driving practice,

unfillable: Driver’s License Number of the signer
The '25 years of age or older' certification option
notes: MVA catalogues the booklet as RD-006 (state_logs.csv); the number is not printed on the log pages. The second (25 or older) certification option is left blank.
Booklet pages 25-27 (15 rows, then 30 rows per page); the certification is on page 28.
The form's certification continues with the 6 hours of instruction and a penalty-of-perjury paragraph; only the first sentence is quoted here, the printed copy carries the full text.
